_doc: Economy of the prison base (scripts/prison/prison_econ.gd). Every number is here. projects: id, building, tier, name, gives (the one plain line the Base screen shows), cost {res: n}, labor (seconds of work by a crew member with `role`), requires (project ids; the tier below the same building is always required), effect. building_role: who works a building (construction labor and, for production, the daily worker). production: per building a list by tier (0 = what the prison has at the start): amt per day with the worker, none without a worker, passive per day always; power: the tier needs the generator running (else the tier below is used). day: seconds of game time in a day. stages: the rules, in order; a stage needs the one before it.

barricades.name: Sandbag line
barricades.blurb: Takes half of the damage the dead do to the wire there while it lasts, and slows them a little.

barricades.name: Spike strip
barricades.blurb: The dead at the wire there are cut as they push, and walk slower.

barricades.name: Tripwire and cans
barricades.blurb: Each of the dead trips on it once and goes down for a moment, and the rattle pulls the pen's dead to that wire, where the guns are. Slows them.

projects.gives: Fresh water every day (a hauler works the pump). Without water people leave within days.
projects.name: Well pump and rain barrels

effect.note: water from the well each day, and more while it rains

projects.gives: Grows the food everyone eats (a gardener tends it). Hunger drags morale down fast.
projects.name: Garden beds

projects.gives: A cook turns food into hot meals: morale up every day, and the larder stops half the spoilage.
projects.name: Kitchen and larder

projects.gives: Two more beds, and a medic treats bites and the sick. Needed to keep people alive and calm.
projects.name: Infirmary

projects.gives: Eight more beds. More people than beds costs morale, and people only come from raids.
projects.name: Bunks

projects.gives: Electricity: floodlights help your guards hit at night. Burns 1 fuel a day. The convoy needs it.
projects.name: Generator and floodlights

effect.note: burns 1 fuel a day; guards hit more at night while it runs

projects.gives: Mends every broken wall of the fence. Cheap, do it before the first nights.
projects.name: Patch the fence

projects.gives: Stronger walls: the dead break through less. The convoy will not load without it.
projects.name: Reinforced fence

projects.gives: Calls survivors to your gate and lets you hear the convoy. The convoy needs it.
projects.name: Radio room

projects.gives: Your own truck for the Harbor Convoy on day 30: eight seats out. The convoy needs it.
projects.name: Convoy truck

effect.note: the vehicle that joins the Harbor Convoy: 8 seats, needs a mechanic
